verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI inference and training platform, since some vendors offer on-prem or customer-cloud deployments, so the axis applies. Every deployment option in the evidence runs on Together's own infrastructure: serverless, dedicated endpoints on reserved hardware, provisioned throughput and GPU clusters. Nothing shows the core platform can be run on a user's own hardware. Community evidence even frames Together as a cheaper alternative to self-hosting.
